description: DAEX (formerly ADE) is a companion controller for the DAEX desktop app. Pair your iPhone with a local DAEX host to monitor Work sessions, lanes, pull requests, files, notifications, widgets, and Live Activities from your workspace. Start chats, review branch state, inspect files, follow PR checks, and keep track of agent progress while the desktop app remains the execution host. DAEX is local-first: your phone syncs with the host you pair, and agents continue to run on your own machine.
promotionalText: Control your DAEX workspace from iPhone: Work sessions, lanes, PRs, files, notifications, widgets, and Live Activities.
